// This file is compiled only through the additive composition-test overlay.
package handlers

import (
	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
	"github.com/kandev/kandev/internal/common/logger"
	"github.com/kandev/kandev/internal/task/ownanswer"
	"github.com/kandev/kandev/internal/task/service"
)

// SyntheticApprovalHandler is absent from every normal build and import.
func SyntheticApprovalHandler(svc *service.Service, repo handlerRepo, log *logger.Logger, expected ownanswer.OwnAnswerBinding) gin.HandlerFunc {
	h := NewTaskHandlers(svc, nil, repo, nil, log)
	return func(c *gin.Context) { h.createApprovalLinkGrant(c, expected) }
}
